How teams form

Register as an individual or as a team of four. A team registers all four members on one form. Students who register individually will be placed on a team by the organizer.

More details will be sent by email closer to the competition date.

How to register

  1. 1

    Register your students

    Register one student as an individual, or a team of four on one form.

  2. 2

    Check your email

    You should receive a confirmation email after you register.

  3. 3

    Pay the school

    Pay on the school's donation page and keep the receipt.

    How to register

    Registration is not open yet. The registration form link will be posted here.

    Open the registration form ↗Continue to school donation page ↗
    1. 1

      Fill out the registration form

      Choose Individual for one student, or Team to register all four team members on one form. Students who register individually will be placed on a team by the organizer.

    2. 2

      Check your email

      You should receive a confirmation email at the address you enter. Keep it for your records. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.

    3. 3

      Pay on the school's donation page

    The organizer confirms payments using the school's records. Keep the school's receipt.
